fixes_applied.description: split appended an extra trailing empty string whenever s ended with the delimiter (under Magma 2.29 Split:IncludeEmpty already includes the trailing empty; the old code's manual 'cat [""]' double-counted it), breaking the documented python r.split(d) semantics and corrupting getrecs on any record with a trailing empty field; it also crashed on the empty string (s[#s] out of range). Fixed to: return #s eq 0 select [""] else Split(s,d:IncludeEmpty).

After fix: split("a:b:",":") = [a,b,''], split(":",":") = ['',''], split("",":") = [''], matching CPython, and putrecs/getrecs now round-trips [["a","b",""],["1","","2"]] exactly.

fixes_applied.description: Same Magma-version drift as split: the manual Append of a trailing empty produced one extra copy of the replacement string when s ends with c (ReplaceCharacter("a:",":","XY") returned "aXYXY"), and the empty string crashed. Fixed by dropping the append and returning s when #s eq 0.
fixes_applied.verification: Before: ReplaceCharacter("a:",":","XY") = "aXYXY", ReplaceCharacter("","a","b") runtime error. After: "aXY", "", and ReplaceCharacter("a:b:",":",";") = "a;b;" as documented.

fixes_applied.description: The Zagier extension H(-u^2) = -u/2 promised by the docstring was dead code: the test was IsSquare(N) with N < 0, always false over Z, so every negative argument returned 0. Changed to IsSquare(-N). Positive arguments unaffected. Note mfdims.m's H12 forwards N le 0 to this intrinsic.
fixes_applied.verification: Before: HurwitzClassNumber(-1,-4,-9) all 0. After: -1/2, -1, -3/2, -2 for -16, and 0 for negative nonsquares -2,-3,-5; positive-argument literature table [-1/12,1/3,1/2,1,...] and the Hurwitz-Kronecker relation sum_{t^2<=4n} H(4n-t^2) = 2*sigma(n) - sum_{d|n} min(d,n/d) verified for n in 1..40, plus Eichler mass relation 2p for p in {2,...,13}.

Fixing would change outputs for ramified primes. Left with a FLAGGED comment in the test file; the one-token fix if multiplicity is intended is weighting the inner multiset by b[2].

notes: All 2 auditors' substantive findings verified independently and confirmed (rejected list is empty). Environment: Magma V2.29-8, where Split(s,d:IncludeEmpty) DOES include trailing empty strings — the split/ReplaceCharacter fixes (and the flagged gl2tab.m colsplit copy) are calibrated to this behavior; on a much older Magma whose Split omitted trailing empties the old code was correct, so if the package must support pre-2.29 versions the maintainer may prefer a version-independent reimplementation. The NormalizedIgusaClebschInvariants GF(p) branch fix is the largest change (one branch reindexed from 5 Igusa slots to the 4 Igusa-Clebsch slots with weights [1,2,3,5]); it was validated by an exhaustive orbit-membership + twist-canonicality sweep over all separable quintics over GF(3), GF(5), GF(7) and the Q branch against LMFDB g2c_curves oracle values (labels 169.a.169.1, 249.a.249.1, hardcoded in the tests with the query cited). The HurwitzClassNumber(-u^2) fix matters downstream: mfdims.m H12(N) forwards N le 0 here. Two intrinsics remain untestable offline: split(RngUPolElt,p) (hardcoded /home/drew Sage path, flagged) and PrimeCount (external primecount binary not installed; code read only). Test suite: tests/test_utils.m, 66 topics, ~233 assert statements (many inside loops, so thousands of executed checks), runs in ~3s wall including spec attach; it contains a regression section comment for every code fix and FLAGGED comments (never asserting current behavior) for the unfixed suspects. git diff -- utils.m reviewed hunk-by-hunk: 11 behavioral fixes + documentation corrections only; nothing committed, all changes left in the working tree. Other modified files in git status belong to sibling owners.

notes: All 36 auditor findings (21 code bugs, 15 doc/annotation bugs) were independently reproduced in Magma before fixing and none were rejected — the three auditors were accurate. Highest-impact fixes for downstream users: Conductor(xi::Map,N) silently returned wrong conductors for imprimitive characters of composite modulus (now matches Magma's builtin Conductor for every character of every modulus N<=45, verified exhaustively); AssociatedCharacter(qq,q,n) silently returned a wrong index instead of erroring when the 2-part of the conductor was 4 and v_2(qq)<=1 (the '(s eq 1 or ee ge 2)' clause is provably exactly the missing condition since (a,s)=(0,1) returns earlier); IsPrimitiveCharacter(label), IsConreyConjugate(label,label) and the OrderBound option of ConreyCharacterOrbitReps were completely non-functional (errored on every valid input). Two behavior-tightening fixes deserve maintainer awareness: (1) label parsing is now anchored, so strings merely containing a label (e.g. \"13.5.7\") are rejected — no repo caller relied on the loose behavior (mfdims.m's string calls pass exact labels); (2) DirichletCharacter/ConreyCharacterAngles/CharacterAngles signatures are now typed, so garbage arguments raise signature errors instead of being silently returned/mis-dispatched — Magma dispatch still resolves mfdims.m's builtin DirichletCharacter(ModSym) call correctly. CharacterOrbitReps(:OrderBound:=1) now returns a List like every other path (was SeqEnum); no caller in the repo uses OrderBound:=1, but external callers relying on the SeqEnum would need adjustment. LMFDB-derived test data (char_dirichlet rows for moduli 13,16,24,25,32,36,40,45,48,49,50,75,100 and 455) is hardcoded with query citations so tests run offline. Sibling owners were editing other files concurrently; the git status shows their modifications — my changes are confined to chars.m and tests/test_chars.m.

flagged.description: CONFIRMED BUG, deliberately not fixed. The pruning step selects conjugates by GrpMatElt ordering (Min([k:k in K]) and comparison with G![1,0,0,1]) but minimality is defined by Eltseq ordering (as GL2MinimalGenerators' docstring warns, these differ: 2880 discordant ordered pairs already in GL(2,Z/4)). When they disagree the pruning discards the conjugates containing the Eltseq-minimal elements and the final result is not minimal. The auditor found 12 wrong outputs at N=4 (e.g. gens [[3,2,0,3]] -> intrinsic [[3,0,2,3]] vs true minimum [[1,2,2,1]]) and validated a fix (prune by A := [Min([Eltseq(k):k in K|k ne Identity(G)]):K in S]) against brute force on 2465 subgroups at N in {2,3,4,5,6,8}.

flagged.why_not_fixed: This intrinsic exists solely to compute the tiebreaker of last resort for RSZB labels. notes: All 40+ auditor findings for gl2base.m were independently re-verified before touching the file (transcript: 42/42 CONFIRMED in a single pre-fix Magma run); none were rejected. Fixes were then applied and re-verified with brute-force oracles in a post-fix run before assembling the test suite. Key points for the maintainer: (1) The GL2Triangular1Subgroup + GL2Borel1PC repair is a coordinated two-intrinsic fix (Schreier transversal T[z]:=a, bottom-right-1 generators, exponent x/a, transpose reduction for Upper:=false); it was validated against brute-force H meet Borel1 over ~120 (N,input) combinations for N in 3..16 in both orientations, including verification that input Order attributes are no longer corrupted (the pre-fix code could set wrong built-in Order attributes, which the file header warns can hang the Magma kernel). GL2Borel1PC's returned group changes from the (undocumented, inconsistent) upper-left-1 group to the documented bottom-right-1 group; GL2Triangular1Subgroup was its only caller. (2) GL2SubgroupKey(H) hash VALUES are unchanged for the default old:=false (verified against the 2-arg overload and by tests/test_gl2tab.m, which pins stored keys, passing unchanged); only the previously-crashing old:=true path is new. (3) GL2RationalCuspCount(H,q) now returns GL2CuspCount(H) whenever q = 1 mod N, which changes (corrects) answers only for det-index>1 groups; gl2points.m consumers re-tested (tests/test_gl2points.m passes). (4) NegOne semantics at N=2 changed for GL2SplitCartan1/GL2Borel1/GL2BorelK1/GL2Arith1/SL1Ambient (now true, since -I=I), which corrects GL2QAdmissible(:MustContainNegativeOne) at level 2. (5) GL2CartanNormalizer(-3,2) now carries Level 1 (it is all of GL(2,Z/2)); CM-twist intrinsics at N=2 re-verified against brute-force twist enumeration. (6) The one confirmed-but-unfixed bug is GL2MinimalConjugate at composite levels (RSZB tiebreaker-of-last-resort); see flagged - fixing it could silently change published RSZB labels, so the decision is left to the maintainer (a validated fix is in the flagged entry). (7) tests/test_gl2base.m merges all six auditor fragments (the 2012-2678 range was double-audited; both fragments included) plus a regression section pinning every fix; ~600 assert statements textually, far more executed via loops; runs in ~7s. It reads/writes the ClassNumberTable cache gl2classno.dat in the repo root (untracked; consider adding to .gitignore alongside *.sig). (8) Sibling-owned files appear modified in git status; only gl2base.m and tests/test_gl2base.m were touched by this task.

notes: All 3 auditor reports were verified adversarially; every bug/doc-bug finding reproduced exactly as claimed and none were rejected. The two independent proposed fixes for newpopa1 (auditors 1 and 3) are mathematically identical; I re-derived their equivalence and re-validated the fix from scratch against ModSym new-subspace traces (321+261 oracle cases, 0 mismatches). The newszp/skp repair chain (ALNewTraces) was re-validated standalone: skp_fixed vs skm 0/1131, newszp_fixed vs newsz 0/921, and newsz itself vs ModSym Atkin-Lehner traces 45/45, so the previously-crashing ALNewTraces default path now agrees with the LMFDB-validated ALNewTrace everywhere tested, including the k=2 non-squarefree-Q class the skp swap corrupted. Design choice worth review: for odd k I made QDimensionCuspForms(N,k)/QDimensionNewCuspForms(N,k) return 0 (matching the package convention that parity-mismatched spaces have dimension 0, cf. DimensionCuspForms) rather than adding a require-error as one auditor suggested. I additionally fixed the recurring docstring typos 'cuspdial'->'cuspidal' (5 sites) and 'charater'->'character' (2 sites) while editing; the comment typo 'ovious' on line 35 was left alone. Dead-code fixes (popa1p double-SNbase, nutl m(1-m)) are unreachable from any intrinsic, so the test suite documents them in comments instead of asserting. tests/test_mfdims.m merges the three auditor fragments deduplicated (all LMFDB-derived values hardcoded with query citations, runs offline; TraceForm tests do require gp on PATH), plus a regression section pinning every fix; it runs in ~3.5s. fixes_applied.description: The ell>=11 elimination loop used Frobenius elements with trace t == 0 (mod l) as witnesses. Such elements lie in the outer coset of BOTH split and nonsplit Cartan normalizers (anti-diagonal / line-swapping elements have trace 0), so KroneckerSymbol(t^2-4d,l) carries no containment information; and u = t^2/d = 0 is the projective-involution case present in every exceptional (A4/S4/A5) subgroup, yet the exceptional test 'u ne 1 and u ne 2 and u ne 4 and (3-u)*u ne 1' passes for u=0. Result: genuinely non-surjective primes were silently dropped, violating the docstring's provable-containment guarantee. Added 'if IsDivisibleBy(t,l) then continue; end if;' after the d-divisibility check, matching Zywina's requirement (arXiv:1508.07661) that only tr != 0 mod l elements be used.

Base-changed to Q(sqrt5) the image is contained in the image over Q, hence still non-surjective at 11, but the buggy code returned []. Instrumented replica of the loop on the same 167 Frobenius matrices: without guard X[11] reaches 7 (11 eliminated) via 38 false split witnesses with t == 0 mod 11 and square c (e.g. t=0,d=19); with guard X[11]=6 and all t != 0 elements have KroneckerSymbol in {-1,0}, exactly the nonsplit-Cartan signature. After fix: 11 in output. Also confirmed no over-retention: base-changed surjective 37.a1 still returns [] with A up to 1024.

notes: All 11 auditor findings were independently re-verified and confirmed; none were rejected. Note for the maintainer: the FldNum PossiblyNonsurjectivePrimes uses GL2SimilarityInvariant from gl2base.m in its 2/3/5/7 blocks while the FldRat version uses the local SimilarityInvariant copy (added 'to make genus1.m independent of gl2base.m') — harmless inside the package but the FldNum intrinsic is not gl2base-independent; left as is. Also left as is: the local variable B in PrecomputeEndomorphismRingData shadows the argument B inside the p-loop (currently harmless since the loop bounds are evaluated first, but fragile). Test asserts are approximate (79 grep hits, several inside loops so the executed count is far higher); suite runs in ~1.3s.
